description: This file defines an interface for persistence operations related to entities, providing methods for purging individual and multiple entities, and utilizing Akka streams for error handling.

classes.name: EntityPersistenceOperations
classes.description: Interface defining persistence operations on entities, particularly the purge operations.

methods.name: purgeEntity
methods.description: Purges a single entity given its EntityId, returning a Source stream ofThrowable error lists.

methods.name: purgeEntities
methods.description: Purges multiple entities given a collection of EntityIds by merging individual purge streams.
